Well worth finding
Sep 2026 • Couples
Good location on top of building with a green oasis inside including water pond. Easy to find just minutes away from times square /opera area. Down an alley with a few restaurants ground floor that were really busy with locals but was worth the walk upstairs to the top. 
Was very quiet when we stopped for lunch but it was out of season. Food was typical home cooked Vietnamese. I had pork pancake which was huge and packed full no shortage of greens. Hubby had a noodle dish again big helpings and of course the mandatory morning glory - delish. 
Staff were very friendly service was quick. Had added bonus of kitten & mum playing show. 
Well worth finding and away from the hoards trying trying to get into the backpacker favourite on times square

Einfach erschreckend!!!
Apr 2026 • Friends
Secret Garden, Ho Chi Minh City
The only good thing about this place is the rooftop location. The terrace on the 5th floor looks nice and has potential — but that’s where the positives end.
Getting there is already a bad start: the elevator wasn’t working, and you have to go through a rather shady, uncomfortable entrance. Not exactly a welcoming experience.
The food was disappointing. What we received looked quite different from what was shown in the menu — misleading at best.
The service, however, was the worst part. The waiter was rude, dismissive, and clearly uninterested. When we asked simple questions, the attitude was sharp and unfriendly. No professionalism at all. When we left, there wasn’t even a basic goodbye.
Overall, a very unpleasant experience and definitely not what you expect from a place with such a nice setting. A real disappointment — especially as it happened at the end of an otherwise great holiday...
Read more
Written April 27, 2026
VuLeAnNgoc
Dear Guest,

Thank you for providing us with your honest feedback regarding your recent visit to Secret Garden (158 Pasteur). We were deeply saddened to read about your experience, especially as it occurred at the end of your holiday. Please accept our sincerest apologies for failing to meet your expectations in almost every regard.

We understand that the entrance through an old apartment building and the climb to the 5th floor can be unexpected. While the elevator is managed by the building complex, we truly regret that its malfunction made your arrival difficult.

More importantly, we are very concerned about your comments regarding our service and food. Providing rude or dismissive service is completely against our standards, and we will be addressing this with our floor team immediately to ensure such an attitude is never repeated. We also take your feedback about the food presentation seriously and will review our menu photos against our current serving standards to ensure accuracy.

We appreciate you highlighting the potential of our rooftop, but we clearly missed the mark on the hospitality that should accompany it. We would value the opportunity to make things right. If you are still in the city or plan to return, please contact us directly so we can personally ensure your next visit is the high-quality experience you deserved.

Thank you again for your feedback, as it helps us improve.

Sincerely,

The Management Team

Good for choose
Apr 2026 • Business
This was my first time visiting this Vietnamese restaurant. I had to go up four floors, and the place is located right on the rooftop, with a unique style that feels completely different from the lively and bustling vibe of Ho Chi Minh City.

The restaurant seemed quite crowded, with a large number of foreign customers like me. The menu offers a wide variety of choices. I would recommend trying the grilled beef and shrimp, as well as the grilled fish.

As for drinks, I found them really good. I highly recommend ordering the “Miss Saigon” cocktail and another one called “Hoi An Story” (or something like that) — they were both unique and delicious. The bartender was very professional, especially when she helped suggest flavors based on my preferences.

I would definitely recommend coming here and giving it a try.

Horrible!
Mar 2026 • Couples
Horrible is the only word that fits: at the bottom of a dark courtyard where dozens of motorcycles are parked, you have to climb 4 awful floors on foot because the elevator is condemned by chains and padlocks. It's already sad, dirty, unseemly. Arriving on the top floor, we see a kitchen (photographed by another customer and visible on this site), not very tasty. Let's go into the large open-air room. Well, we're reassured that sounds more inviting. We wait... A lot... After twenty minutes, I get up and go check with a waiter to finally take our order (other people entered after us had already been able to place an order.)
The dishes are coming... Mine was really not good: the pork I had to roll in a stiff rice leaf with some vegetables and herbs was overcooked and totally tasteless. I left much of the dish. 
Belly a little hollow, I thought I was going to have dessert for once. Bad took me: again a good 15 minutes waiting without any server moving to see if by chance a client would need anything. So I finally get up. I approach the kitchen: one of the waiters was on his cell phone and two waitresses were playing with a small dog... I demand the menu again. We study the short dessert menu... then wait. Nobody's coming. We ended up getting paid and leaving. Don’t waste your time, breath and money: go your way.

Nous vous remercions d'avoir pris le temps de nous faire part de votre expérience, bien que nous soyons profondément désolés et navrés de lire que votre visite a été si décevante. Vos commentaires sont essentiels pour nous permettre de corriger nos manquements.

Nous comprenons votre frustration et votre décision de ne pas revenir, mais nous vous remercions de nous avoir alertés sur ces problèmes graves. Nous allons travailler sans relâche pour que de telles situations ne se reproduisent plus.
